escalations.title: Arbitrary Code Execution in protobufjs (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.trigger: security — critical RCE in orchestrator infrastructure
escalations.recommendation: Upgrade protobufjs to >=7.5.5 and @grpc/grpc-js to >=1.14.4 immediately. Isolate orchestrator from untrusted input until patched.

escalations.title: JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion in handlebars
escalations.recommendation: Audit all handlebars template usage in Source/Backend. Upgrade to latest handlebars or remove if not needed. Block deployment until resolved.

escalations.title: Unidentified Critical CVE in Source/Frontend dependencies
escalations.trigger: security — critical severity, unidentified, requires immediate triage
escalations.recommendation: Rerun 'npm audit --json' in Source/Frontend with extended timeout. Identify package and CVE before next deployment.

findings.title: ReDoS via multiple route parameters in path-to-regexp
findings.recommendation: Upgrade Express, which will pull in a fixed path-to-regexp. Pin >=0.1.13.

findings.title: Server crash via malformed/compressed requests in @grpc/grpc-js
Multiple DoS vulnerabilities in brace-expansion
findings.recommendation: Upgrade brace-expansion to >=1.1.18 via npm update.

findings.title: Unbounded memory growth leading to OOM in browserslist

findings.title: Route handlers import store directly — bypasses service layer
findings.recommendation: Create workItemService.ts wrapping store calls. Route handlers import only from services/.

findings.title: Missing dependencyCheckDuration histogram — FR-dependency-metrics incomplete
findings.recommendation: Add Histogram named dependency_check_duration_seconds. Instrument detectCycle() and isReady().

findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to portal/ — 85 FRs unguarded by automated gate
findings.recommendation: Create Plans/dev-workflow-platform/requirements.md for portal FRs or add second enforcer invocation.

findings.title: spec-drift-report.json stale — shows 0% coverage with phantom FR-TMP-* IDs
findings.recommendation: Delete or regenerate spec-drift-report.json using the current traceability enforcer.

findings.title: Fast-track heuristic (complexity) deviates from spec (< 3 files) without documentation
findings.recommendation: Update workflow-engine.md to document complexity heuristic, or implement estimatedFiles field.

findings.title: Duplicate logger: logger.ts compat shim + utils/logger.ts implementation
findings.recommendation: Canonicalize on utils/logger.ts, add default export, delete logger.ts shim.

findings.title: eslint-disable suppresses react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in 2 hooks without explanation
findings.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining why dependency is safely omitted, or fix the hook.

findings.title: workflow-engine.md has no FR IDs — domain spec cannot be machine-enforced
findings.recommendation: Add FR-WF-XXX anchors to workflow-engine.md requirements tables or formally document Plans/ as sole enforced contract.

cross_references.description: The traceability enforcer does not cover portal/ FRs (QO-003), and the dependency audit timed out on portal projects (DEP-P4-002). Both reflect that portal receives less governance than Source/.
cross_references.single_fix: Onboard portal/ into CI gates: add enforcer coverage (Plans/dev-workflow-platform/requirements.md) and add npm audit to portal CI jobs with adequate timeout.

cross_references.description: All 3 P1 CVEs and all P2 dependency findings would be caught automatically with continuous dependency scanning. Their presence indicates no automated gate exists.
cross_references.single_fix: Add npm audit --audit-level=high to CI. Enable Dependabot or Snyk. Establish P1 SLA of 72 hours and P2 SLA of 2 weeks.
